_README.purpose: Battle-physics attributes for each part, kept SEPARATE from the radar stats (part_stats.json) and the parts catalog (parts.json). Radar stats are for the spider chart; THESE numbers drive the simulation. Keeping them apart means you can tune battle balance without touching display data.
_README.how_to_expand: Add an entry under the matching class map (blades/ratchets/bits) keyed by release code. Any field you omit falls back to the class default in `defaults`. Add a new gimmick by giving a part a `gimmick` id and implementing that id in the engine's gimmick registry.
_README.key: Entries are keyed by release code (e.g. 'BX-01'). If two parts share a code, suffix with the base name: 'BX-46:Cobalt Drake'.
_README.units: mass in grams, lengths in mm, angles in degrees, time in seconds, angularVelocity in rad/s. The engine normalizes to its own world units on load.

notes_on_fields.blade.attack: Higher = more HP drained from the opponent per hit and more knockback dealt.
notes_on_fields.blade.elasticity: 0..1 restitution. Low = absorbs impact (defense-ish), high = bounces away hard (aggressive/erratic).
notes_on_fields.blade.spinDir: 'right' or 'left'. Opposite-spin collisions transfer more energy (canonical Beyblade behavior).
notes_on_fields.ratchet.protrusions: The N in e.g. '9-60'. More protrusions => higher burst resistance and LOWER chance to return from a corner pocket.
notes_on_fields.ratchet.heightMm: The mm in e.g. '9-60'. LOWER height => higher burst resistance (per user's rule). Exceptions handled via override.
notes_on_fields.ratchet.burstResistanceBias: Manual +/- nudge for exceptions like CX-07 that don't follow the protrusions/height rule.
notes_on_fields.bit.friction: Contact friction with the floor. Higher = sheds speed & HP faster but more stable.
notes_on_fields.bit.maneuverability: How much the bit wanders/drifts. attack high, defense ~0.
notes_on_fields.bit.returnToCenter: Tendency to settle at stadium center (entropy). stamina/defense high, attack low.
notes_on_fields.bit.gimmick: Optional id resolved by the engine's gimmick registry (e.g. 'spin_decay_shift').

gimmickParams.note: Stamina-first; when spin (HP) drops below 40% it behaves like an attack type.
